text: N=128 seed 23 (m2 fixed, data_seed 0) reaches val_mse_ratio 0.0052 at step 24000. If the N=64 seed 23 12000-step run is read at the checkpoint closest to that loss, at layer 1 (control plus margin), is the same-layer force gap still ≥0.04? That would confirm the N=128 ceiling holds at matched loss and not only at matched or longer training.
